title: KnownMcpServerWithStatus
description:
Wire-shape DTO returned by the `/library/.../status` REST endpoints.
Carries the catalog metadata for a server (from
KnownMcpServerCatalog or a custom-server source) plus the
per-request integration status (from KnownMcpServerStatusInfo).

id.description: Gets the unique identifier for the server.

provider.description: Gets the known MCP server provider identifier.

type.description: Gets the server type (Remote, Sandbox, Hosted, McpLink).

name.description: Gets the display name of the server.

description.description: Gets the brief description of the server.

scopes.description: Gets the OAuth scopes required by the server.

tags.description: Gets the tags associated with the server.

category.description: Gets the category of the server.

status.description: Gets the catalog status of the server.

availability.description: Gets the availability of the server.

featured.description: Gets a value indicating whether this server is featured.

longDescription.description: Gets the detailed description of the server.

features.description: Gets the list of key features.

oneOf.description: Gets the UI configuration for the server.

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Gets the request timeout in seconds.

oneOf.description: Gets the test endpoint configuration for credential validation.

images.description: Gets the images for the MCP server.

oneOf.description: Gets the documentation links for the MCP server.
Gets the system requirements for locally installed apps.

addedDate.description: Gets the date when the app was added to the catalog.

oneOf.description: Gets the various links related to the app.
Gets the authentication type currently configured for the calling tenant, if any.

state.description:
Gets the unified connection state — the FE-aligned ubiquitous-language
projection of (integration row state, personal-cred presence,
catalog requirements). Single source of truth for connection state
across REST and gRPC. Always present on the wire; defaults to
McpConnectionState McpConnectionState.NeedsSetup.

url.description: Gets or sets the URL of the landing page.

screenshot.description: Gets or sets the screenshot URL for the landing page.

LandingPage.description: Landing page information for the MCP server.

mainSite.description: Gets or sets the main site URL.

documentation.description: Gets or sets the documentation URL.

apiKeyCreation.description: Gets or sets the API key creation URL.

Links.description: Various links related to the MCP server.

McpConnectionOutcome.description:
Coarse outcome of an MCP server's connection state — the FE-aligned ubiquitous
            language used end-to-end across BE and FE to drive UI affordances.
            One outcome per state; string? McpConnectionState.Reason refines an
McpConnectionOutcome.Error outcome with a machine-readable code from
McpConnectionReasons.

outcome.description: Gets the coarse outcome — the ubiquitous language shared across BE and FE.

disabled.description:
Gets a value indicating whether an admin has disabled this integration at
the tenant level. Orthogonal to McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome: the outcome still
reflects the underlying connection readiness, so re-enabling needs no
re-derivation. Only a configured row can be disabled.

reason.description:
Gets the machine-readable reason from McpConnectionReasons,
or null when none applies. Set for McpConnectionOutcome.Error,
for Connected plus string McpConnectionReasons.RefreshPending, and
for NeedsSetup plus
string McpConnectionReasons.SchemaCredentialNotConfigured.

reasonDetails.description:
Gets optional developer-facing detail refining the reason (e.g. UCS error
code, exception message). May be surfaced in logs and ProblemDetails but
must not be used for end-user UI strings.

interactiveAvailable.description:
Gets a value indicating whether an interactive personal-OAuth connect,
setup, or reconnect can clear this classification. Present as
`true` only for `not_configured`,
`awaiting_credentials`, `credential_invalid`, and
`misconfigured` when the primary credential of an interactive
personal-OAuth source is the cause. Absent (`null`) for
non-interactive sources, Connected results, and reasons a primary
connect cannot clear. Never `false`.

oneOf.description:
Gets the recovery action for this classification. Null on an unstamped
singleton (omitted from JSON and gRPC). A stamped wire state always
carries a value other than RecoveryCommand.Unspecified.
Absent means the client keeps today's derivation. Present is authoritative
and replaces reading string? McpConnectionState.Reason to choose Connect, Reconnect,
Configure, or Save credential.

McpConnectionState.description:
State-only view of an MCP server connection — the wire-shape primitive that
            every transport (REST, gRPC, SignalR push, future Orleans grain messages)
            can carry without dragging the entire `McpServerConfiguration`
            along. The build-outcome wrapper `McpConnectionResult` composes a
            state with the optional built configuration.
            Shape contract:* McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is always set.
* string? McpConnectionState.Reason is set when
                McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is McpConnectionOutcome.Error (from
                McpConnectionReasons), when McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is
                McpConnectionOutcome.Connected and the value is
                string McpConnectionReasons.RefreshPending, or when
                McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is McpConnectionOutcome.NeedsSetup
                and the value is
                string McpConnectionReasons.SchemaCredentialNotConfigured. Other
                Connected and NeedsSetup results keep string? McpConnectionState.Reason null.
                Unknown non-error reasons are informational and never a gate.
* string? McpConnectionState.ReasonDetails is an optional human-readable refinement
                (UCS error code, exception message) intended for logs and developer-facing
                diagnostics — not for end-user UI strings.
* Exception? McpConnectionState.Error is the original exception when the outcome was
                caused by one. Internal use only — never serialized.
* bool McpConnectionState.Disabled is an orthogonal admin-disable flag — it can
                be true alongside any McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome (a Connected or NeedsAuth
                server can still be admin-disabled), so it does not collapse into the
                readiness outcome.
* bool? McpConnectionState.InteractiveAvailable is present (`true`)
                only for a user-recoverable classification of an interactive personal-OAuth
                source. It is omitted (`null`) otherwise and is never
                `false`.
* RecoveryCommand? McpConnectionState.RecoveryCommand is the recovery action. It is omitted
                (`null`) on an unstamped singleton so an old payload stays
                absent. A present value is authoritative. RecoveryCommand.Unspecified
                is never stored.

WARNING: User Credential Store currently does not support separate refresh endpoints.

grantType.description: Gets or sets the grant type (default: Authorization Code with PKCE).

scopeSeparator.description: Gets or sets the scope separator character (default: space).

tokenEndpointAuthMethod.description: Gets or sets the token endpoint authentication method.

codeChallengeMethodsSupported.description: Gets or sets the code challenge methods supported for PKCE (e.g., "S256", "plain").

tokenParameters.description: Gets or sets additional parameters to include in token requests.

tokenHeaders.description: Gets or sets additional headers to include in token requests.

OAuthConfig.description:
OAuth-specific configuration for Manual OAuth providers.
Contains OAuth endpoint URLs and behavior configuration.

transport.description: Gets or sets the transport protocol (e.g., "sse" for Server-Sent Events).

connectionTimeoutSeconds.description: Gets or sets the connection timeout in seconds.

autoReconnect.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to automatically reconnect on disconnect.

maxReconnectAttempts.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of reconnection attempts.

endpointConfig.description: Gets or sets additional endpoint-specific configuration.

uri.description: Gets or sets the remote server URI.

uriVariables.description:
Gets or sets the URI variables that can be substituted in the URI.
Used for dynamic parameterization (e.g., {zone} for region, {token} for API keys).

headers.description:
Gets or sets HTTP headers to be sent with requests.
Supports both static headers and dynamic placeholders like {AuthToken} and {BasicAuth:VarName}.
For auth-type-specific headers (e.g., different Authorization formats), use AuthHeaders instead.

oneOf.description:
Gets or sets OAuth-specific configuration for Manual OAuth providers.
Contains OAuth endpoints and behavior configuration.

authHeaders.description:
Gets or sets auth-type-specific HTTP headers.
Keys are auth types (e.g., "ApiKey", "OAuth"), values are header dictionaries.
When a specific auth type is selected, headers from AuthHeaders[authType] are merged with/override base Headers.
This allows different Authorization header formats per auth type (e.g., "Basic {AuthToken}" for ApiKey, "Bearer {AuthToken}" for OAuth).

bodyParams.description:
Gets or sets parameters to inject into request bodies for MCP-Link servers.
Used for APIs that require authentication in the request body (e.g., Canny's apiKey parameter).
Supports {AuthToken} placeholder for dynamic auth token injection.
Only applies to McpLink server types - regular remote servers ignore this property.

oAuthResourceUrl.description:
Gets or sets the OAuth protected resource URL for DCR registration.
When set, this URL is sent as `ResourceUrl` to UCS instead of string? RemoteServerConfig.Uri,
enabling RFC 9728 (Protected Resource Metadata) discovery against an external OAuth provider
(e.g., Atlassian) while routing MCP traffic through the internal mcp-link service.

useAcc.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether to route traffic through the ACC connector.
When true, the gateway routes traffic for this server through the tenant's on-premise
ACC connector instead of direct HTTP. Transport mechanism TBD (MCPG-455 Phase 3).

schemaHeaders.description:
Gets or sets HTTP headers serialized into mcp-link's `?sh=` query parameter for
OpenAPI spec fetching at session start (MCPG-756). Values may contain
`{SchemaCredential:FieldName}` placeholders, resolved at factory time against the
binder declared by string? RemoteServerConfig.SchemaCredentialProviderName and the per-tenant
SchemaCredentialBinderId on the integration row. Only applies to McpLink server types.

schemaCredentialProviderName.description:
Gets or sets the UCS provider name used to resolve the secondary spec-fetch credential
(e.g. `"GithubPersonalAccessToken"`). Free-form string matching a provider in UCS
provider-definitions.json. The binder ID is selected per-tenant at integration-config
time and stored on the ProviderIntegration row, sibling to `CredentialProviderConfigId`.
Only meaningful when Dictionary<string, string>? RemoteServerConfig.SchemaHeaders contains a `{SchemaCredential:*}`
placeholder. Only applies to McpLink server types.

accGroupId.description:
Gets or sets the ACC connector group to route traffic through when bool RemoteServerConfig.UseAcc is true.
Null means "any connector for this tenant" (tenant-default routing).
Ignored when bool RemoteServerConfig.UseAcc is false.

openApiYamlUrl.description:
Gets or sets the customer-supplied OpenAPI YAML URL for SpecLink (private-spec) custom servers (MCPG-803).
When set, the gateway infers `Type = McpLink` server-side and builds the canonical mcp-link URI
from this value + string? RemoteServerConfig.UpstreamApiBaseUrl. Ignored when both are null. Only meaningful on
custom servers created via the SpecLink wizard; seed entries use string? RemoteServerConfig.Uri directly.

upstreamApiBaseUrl.description:
Gets or sets the upstream API base URL that the YAML at string? RemoteServerConfig.OpenApiYamlUrl describes (MCPG-803).
May contain `{Variable}` placeholders (e.g. `https://{Domain}.atlassian.net`) whose values are
stored in Dictionary<string, string>? RemoteServerConfig.UpstreamVariableValues and substituted gateway-side at connection-build time
(mcp-link does not expand base-URL variables). Used together with string? RemoteServerConfig.OpenApiYamlUrl to build
the canonical mcp-link URI server-side.

upstreamVariableValues.description: Gets or sets the values for the `{Variable}` placeholders in string? RemoteServerConfig.UpstreamApiBaseUrl (MCPG-803), keyed by variable name without braces (e.g. `{"CloudId": "abc-123"}`). Unlike the URL fields these are persisted — the stored string? RemoteServerConfig.Uri only carries the unresolved template, so the values are not derivable from it. Substituted into the canonical URI at connection-build time by `SpecLinkUriResolver`. Only meaningful for SpecLink (McpLink) servers.

skillRepoUrl.description:
Gets or sets the repository URL exposed through mcp-link skills mode.
The current mcp-link contract accepts public github.com URLs.
Transport-only: re-derived from string? RemoteServerConfig.Uri on responses and not persisted.

skillRepoRef.description:
Gets or sets the optional Git ref used for skill discovery.
When omitted, mcp-link resolves the repository's default branch.
Transport-only: re-derived from string? RemoteServerConfig.Uri on responses and not persisted.

skillRepoPath.description:
Gets or sets the optional repository-relative subpath used for skill discovery.
Transport-only: re-derived from string? RemoteServerConfig.Uri on responses and not persisted.

skillRepoProvider.description:
Gets or sets the repository host backing a SkillLink server, from
SkillRepoProviders. Defaults to
string SkillRepoProviders.GitHub when a SkillLink shape is saved without one.

sourceRef.description:
Gets or sets the source ref the administrator configured for a SpecLink or SkillLink server
(MCPG-1891): the branch or tag name (for example `main`) that string? RemoteServerConfig.SourceRevision
was resolved from. Null for a content-hash pin (a non-GitHub spec URL) and for an unpinned row.

sourceRevision.description:
Gets or sets the pinned source revision (MCPG-1891): the full 40-hex commit SHA for a GitHub
source, or the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the fetched document for any other https spec URL.
The canonical string? RemoteServerConfig.Uri embeds this value (as `ref=` inside `s=`, as the
skills `ref=`, or as the `v=` query parameter), which is what makes an explicit
refresh a guaranteed cache miss on every mcp-link replica. Null when the row is unpinned.

sourceResolvedAt.description:
Gets or sets the instant string? RemoteServerConfig.SourceRevision was last resolved (MCPG-1891).
Null when the row is unpinned.

Gets or sets the URI of the test endpoint.
Supports variable substitution (e.g., {AuthToken}).

method.description: Gets or sets the HTTP method to use (GET, POST, etc.).

Gets or sets the headers to include in the request.
Supports variable substitution in values (e.g., "Bearer {AuthToken}").

expectedStatusCodes.description: Gets or sets the expected HTTP status codes that indicate success.

TestEndpointConfig.description:
Configuration for testing credentials against an external API endpoint.
Used to validate authentication before establishing a full MCP connection.

colorClass.description: Gets or sets the Tailwind CSS text color class.

bgGradient.description: Gets or sets the Tailwind CSS gradient classes.

UiConfiguration.description: UI configuration for the MCP server display.

description.description: Gets or sets the human-readable description of this variable.

required.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this variable is required.

options.description:
Gets or sets the available options for this variable (e.g., ["eu", "us"] for region).
Only applicable for variables with predefined choices.

defaultValue.description: Gets or sets the default value for this variable.

placeholder.description: Gets or sets the placeholder text to show in the UI.

helpText.description: Gets or sets additional help text for this variable.

type.description:
Gets or sets the variable type hint for UI rendering (e.g., "string", "integer", "url").
Used for UI validation and input control selection, but all values are ultimately strings.

scope.description:
Gets or sets the authentication types this variable applies to.
If null or empty, the variable applies to all authentication types (backward compatible).
If specified, the variable is only shown/validated for the listed auth types (e.g., ["ApiKey"], ["OAuth"], or ["ApiKey", "OAuth"]).

sharing.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this variable may be inherited onto another
user's Personal overlay at read time (MCPG-1609). The overlay runs only for OAuth/Fhir
Personal target rows. Omitted / default is UriVariableSharing.Shared.
Only UriVariableSharing.Personal is written in the seed.
Does not constrain a Tenant-level row, which is shared by design.
The name Scope is taken on this model for auth-type filtering.

UriVariable.description:
Represents a URI variable that can be substituted in remote MCP server URIs.
Used for dynamic parameterization of server endpoints (e.g., region, API keys).
All variables are treated as strings for URL substitution.

UriVariableSharing.description:
Whether a catalog URI variable may be inherited onto another user's Personal overlay
at read time (MCPG-1609). The overlay runs only for OAuth/Fhir Personal target rows.
Absent / default is UriVariableSharing.Shared so hostname and instance variables inherit
without marking every seed entry. Only UriVariableSharing.Personal is written in seed.
Does not constrain a Tenant-level row, which is shared by design.

title.description: Gets or sets the title of the video.

url.description: Gets or sets the URL of the video.

type.description: Gets or sets the type of video (e.g., "youtube").

embedUrl.description: Gets or sets the embed URL for the video.
